title: Employees and their departments
description: Return each employee's name as employee_name and their department's name as department_name.
expected_query: SELECT e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.id;

title: Orders with customer names
description: Return each order's id as order_id and the customer's name as customer_name.
expected_query: SELECT o.id AS order_id, c.name AS customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id;

title: Departments including empty ones
description: Return every department's name as department_name and its number of employees as employee_count. Departments with no employees must appear with a count of 0.
expected_query: SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;

title: Customer spending
description: For orders that are not cancelled, return each customer's name as customer_name and the total value of their items (quantity times product price) as total_spent. Sort by total_spent, highest first.
expected_query: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
